title: Resume deferred local portfolio runs automatically
description:
As an operator, I want a locally launched portfolio run to continue through its own scheduled publication retry, so that a transient artifact-publication interruption cannot leave the run overdue indefinitely.

Out of scope: general account-wide task dispatch, schema changes, automatic promotion, and exposing sensitive artifact identifiers or provider error content.

Feature: Targeted continuation of a deferred local run

Scenario: The exact deferred run continues when due
Given a locally launched portfolio run has durably deferred a retry for a UTC time
When the retry time becomes due
Then the same local command rearms and executes only that exact Procedure and Task
And the run continues from its durable checkpoint

Scenario: An unrelated pending task is not executed
Given other account tasks are pending
When the targeted continuation becomes due
Then only the exact deferred parent Task is claimed
And no account-wide pending-task scan is used

Scenario: A publication interruption preserves resumable evidence
Given a milestone publishes many verified artifacts
When publication is interrupted after a partial batch
Then the verified descriptors are durably indexed in bounded batches
And the retry reuses verified artifacts instead of uploading them again

Scenario: Failure telemetry remains safe and useful
Given milestone publication raises an exception
When the run records a retryable publication failure
Then it records the exception class, operation category, completed count, total count, and retry classification
And it records no artifact names, keys, opaque resource IDs, or content

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Read-only dogfood evidence: one local portfolio run durably deferred a report-publication retry, exited, and remained overdue because no exact-procedure continuation owner was alive. Published progress stopped partway through a large artifact set; the precise interruption class and operation were not retained. Work begins with targeted-resume and safe-telemetry specifications; no general pending-task scan will be introduced.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Implemented the direct-local continuation owner and safe publication failure telemetry outside-in. The same local command now waits for its due retry, conditionally rearms only its exact Procedure/Task, and replays the indexed checkpoint. Full focused portfolio/report/resume/dispatch validation: 288 passed. No account-wide pending-task dispatcher is used.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Added durable draft-verification reuse: a checksum-valid partial-publication manifest now carries forward its already verified artifact descriptors across process replay, avoiding one GraphQL ticket and HTTPS read per recovered score artifact. The corruption check for committed legacy artifacts remains intact. Combined focused suite: 293 passed.
